title: Allocated mission visibility and activation-request gate
goal: Expose the canonical V2-008D allocation in OTHRYS OS and allow a separate Trust Canal activation request without activating or executing the mission.
laws: Candidate evidence remains immutable; allocation binding supplies canonicalMissionId.
Only CANONICAL_UNACTIVATED missions may request activation.
Activation request is a separate authenticated tablet intent and Trust Canal receipt.
Admission of activation request does not change canonical mission status.
No Talos, Hephaestus, Worker, model, shell, mutation, or execution is started.
Request replay is idempotent and malformed mission identity fails closed.
The tablet must visibly distinguish allocated from activated.
